name: Iris Translucent Order Fix
description: Backport of IrisShaders/Iris PR #3151 for Iris 1.11.2+mc26.2: when the shader pack does not set separateEntityDraws, translucent features (piglins, players, item-frame maps, sign text...) are drawn before deferred like before 26.1. Fixes see-through entities/maps with Sundial Lite (GeForceLegend/Sundial-Lite#24). Disable with -Diristranslucentorder=false.
